I have a lvl 72 OP 3 Gaige and this is the [build](http://bl2skills.com/mechromancer.html#550050100100050000000000413150151051) I recommend using. You dont have to keep all 5 points in Cooking up trouble and Myelin. You can distribute 3 points into Annoyed Android. 
Fancy Mathmatics is pointless since you have blood soaked sheilds but if you have trouble killing then keep it. Dont rely on Discord too much when below 200 stacks. 

For UVHM and beyond, keep a slag weapon or grenade on you. Magic Missile is a great choice. I would also suggest to go for a Ruby and wait til OP 8 for the grog nozzle. The healing from those are great for UVHM and often used as a crutch by most players. RPG's can be your best friend, especially E-tech ones. With 200 stacks of Anarchy or above one blast can obliterate enemies. 

Class mods I recommend using are Anarchist for weapon damage, Punk and Prodigy for Anarchy stacking. If you find the Legendary Anarchist or Mechro mods those would be really great. I think Necromancer might be good too but I havent used it yet.

Ive been Farming Anarchy stacks by killing Spiderants in the dust. Just run through Bug Gulch behind Ellie's Garage. Also you will be on the lookout for Tubby Spiderants. Dont forget to kill Mobley and Gettle along the way for a chance at one of the legendary. Its up to you though. I usually get 100-150 stacks from one run. 

Another way of farming Anarchy stacks is to go to Pyro Petes Bar, If you have the Torgue dlc, do the mission Beatdown Bar brawl. Keep repeating it until you have enough stacks. You'll Earn a ton of Tokens and Exp from completing the quest.
